name: Foreign Exchange
description: Spot and forward FX, FX options, and currency exposure.

dimensions.name: currency_pair
dimensions.description: Currency pair in market quoting order (e.g., EURUSD)

metrics.name: spot_rate
metrics.description: Spot exchange rate in the pair's quoting convention

metrics.name: net_exposure
metrics.description: Net currency position at a point in time, in reporting currency

metrics.name: carry
metrics.description: Annualized interest differential earned holding the pair

conventions.rule: Quote pairs in market convention (base/quote) and state direction: a rising EURUSD is euro appreciation.
A pip is 0.0001 for most pairs and 0.01 for JPY pairs.
Name the fixing (e.g., WM/Reuters 4pm London) used for any reported rate.

insight_rules.reason: Exchange rates are prices, not quantities; aggregate exposures, not rates.

caveats.text: Direction depends on quoting convention; the response states which currency strengthened.

chart_conventions.rule: Compare currencies against one base as indexed lines, all quoted the same direction.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
